integrity: The universal conclusion is proved analytically by exact drift cancellation, a pathwise Ornstein--Uhlenbeck comparison, and an explicit Gaussian distribution. The accompanying checker only verifies the algebraic cancellation and a representative numerical evaluation; it is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns Eq. (24) exactly as printed with additive Brownian terms and does not assess multiplicative, reflected, truncated, or other repaired stochastic models. It establishes a positive probability of failure of strict positive-orthant invariance at every positive time, not a full law for the first-exit time. General non-invariance under additive noise is standard SDE intuition; the new content is the source-specific exact total-coordinate comparison, quantitative Gaussian lower bound, and proof/model mismatch.
title: Additive Brownian forcing breaks positivity in the stochastic syphilis model
